evals.name: multi-team-coordination
evals.prompt: ho due team che lavorano sullo stesso repo, uno sul backend Go e uno sul frontend React. Vorrei usare ntm per coordinare 5 agenti totali senza che si pestino i piedi sui file. Come faccio?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend labeled sessions (--label), file reservations (ntm mail reserve), pre-commit guard, and dashboard monitoring. Should load session-management.md and agent-communication.md references.

assertions.text: Recommends --label flag for multi-swarm on same project
Includes ntm mail reserve with glob patterns for file paths
Mentions ntm hooks guard install for pre-commit protection
Provides concrete spawn command with correct agent counts
Does NOT suggest creating separate session names as primary approach

evals.name: ci-cd-integration
evals.prompt: devo integrare ntm nella mia pipeline CI per fare code review automatiche con 2 agenti Claude prima di ogni merge, voglio output JSON parsabile. Come lo imposto?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend robot mode (--robot-spawn, --robot-send, --robot-ack, --robot-files) for CI/CD. Should NOT recommend ntm serve for a CI script. Should show a complete bash script example.

assertions.text: Includes --robot-ack with timeout for completion detection
Includes session cleanup (ntm kill) at the end
Does NOT recommend ntm serve for this CI use case

evals.name: debug-recovery
evals.prompt: un agente si e' stallato durante una sessione lunga, il dashboard mostra STALLED. Come recupero senza perdere il contesto?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend diagnostic steps: check health, inspect pane output with --robot-tail, check context usage, then recovery options (interrupt+re-prompt, or checkpoint+resume). Should load troubleshooting.md and advanced-patterns.md.

assertions.text: Suggests ntm health or --robot-tail to diagnose the stall
Mentions context rotation as automatic recovery mechanism
Provides recovery steps (interrupt + re-prompt or checkpoint + resume)
Does NOT immediately suggest killing the session
